source.sample: 591 endplates from 76 male lumbosacral spines; mean age 51.3 years
source.access: publisher abstract available; level-specific full table not recovered

disc_relative_mapping.cranial_endplate: inferior endplate of vertebra ABOVE disc
disc_relative_mapping.caudal_endplate: superior endplate of vertebra BELOW disc
disc_relative_mapping.warning: Cranial/caudal are relative to disc, not relative to the same vertebral body.

geometry_implications: Both facing bone surfaces may be concave into their respective bones; central gap can differ from rim gap.
Do not collapse body height, central concavity, disc mean height and endplate-normal separation into one stick length.
A positive centre gap does not prove positive gap across contact footprint.
allowed_current_use: Surface representation and measurement-semantics constraint; pooled source depths are not assigned level-specific targets.
required_next: Level-specific endplate shape/footprint and height protocol before global vertebral centre placement.
